The Cadmean Threshold
Carved into the limestone archway above the sealed subterranean door is a relief of a crested serpent coiled around a bronze tripod. The archaic letters read:

"Speak the sacred name of the earth-born guardian born of Ares, whose venomous teeth were sown into Boeotian soil by the founder Cadmus."
How will you unseal the threshold?
Or speak a custom name into the rock:
♕
Hero of Cithaeron
The Whispering Fissure of Mount Cithaeron - Completed
Through courage in battle, pious reverence to Hermes, and mythological wisdom before the Cadmean Threshold, you have rescued the consecrated sacrificial ram and preserved the sacred rites of Plataea!
• Title Conferred: Protector of the Pastures
• Relic Acquired: Archaic Bronze Bell of Hermes (+2 Divine Favour)
• Rewards: 30 Silver Drachmae • +25 Heroic Renown (Kleos)
• Standing: Revered Friend among the people of Boeotia

The Threshold of Hades
Hermes Psychopompos & The Loom of the Fates
Your vision darkens as cold mist gathers on the limestone scree. As your knees strike the earth, the silver herald's wand of Hermes Psychopompos glimmers through the gloom.

"Rise, mortal of Hellas," the whisper echoes as if from the distant groves of Elysium. "Your shade is not yet summoned across the dark waters of Acheron; your heroic destiny remains unfulfilled upon the earth."

Guided by the immortal herald, you are carried back from the brink of Tartarus to the nearest sacred sanctuary.
• Awakened at: Sanctuary
• Condition: Revived
• Time Passed: 12 hours
